label: Customer
hint: Company name as it should appear in the lockup and H1.

label: Territory
hint: States, regions or service area the hex twin should map.
example: Oregon and Washington service territory (Willamette Valley to Puget Sound), plus the Columbia River Gorge

label: Leadership audience
hint: Who reads the page and what they own.
example: CIO, CISO and VP Grid Operations at Northwind Power, plus their direct staff

label: Goal of the page
hint: What the leave-behind must achieve after the meeting.
example: Leave IT leadership with a sourced view of how Splunk and Cisco support Northwind's wildfire-season operations and CIP-015 program, and agree on two roadmap options to scope

label: Cisco and Splunk topic
hint: The theme the story is built around.
example: Agentic operations with Cisco Cloud Control on the Splunk data fabric: wildfire public-safety power shutoffs, OT security and CIP-015 INSM

label: Sites and functions on the twin
hint: 15 to 20 sites with type and approximate location; these become hex-map beacons.
example: Portland HQ (hq, 45.52,-122.68); Salem control center (substation, 44.94,-123.03); Bonneville tie (substation, 45.64,-121.94); Hood River wind (wind, 45.7,-121.5); Klamath gas plant (gas, 42.2,-121.8); Puget data center cluster (datacenter, 47.25,-122.3); Customer Ops (cx, 45.3,-122.9); Columbia Generating Station PPA (nuclear, 46.47,-119.33)

label: Time budget (hours)
hint: Hours for research, build and review.

label: Prepared by
hint: Team or person named in the kicker and footer.
example: Splunk, a Cisco company, Northwind account team

label: Platform they already run
hint: Splunk and Cisco products already in production; marked 'in place' everywhere.
example: Splunk Cloud Platform, Splunk Enterprise Security (standard), Cisco Secure Firewall, Cisco ISE

label: Current joint work
hint: Active engagement that powers the 'Our work together' section.
example: Moving OT telemetry from substations into Splunk Cloud through Edge Processor for wildfire-season monitoring

label: Regulatory frame
hint: Regulations and dates that anchor the roadmap.
example: NERC CIP-015-1 INSM (effective Oct 1, 2028), Oregon PUC wildfire mitigation plans, TSA pipeline security directive for gas assets

label: Catalysts
hint: Merger, build-out, deadlines or events that make it timely.
example: $9B five-year capital plan, two hyperscale data center interconnections, 2027 wildfire mitigation plan refresh

label: Mission or critical customers
hint: Federal, defense, hospital or other critical customers (section 9). Write 'none' to drop the section.
example: Joint Base Lewis-McChord and regional hospitals on critical feeders

label: Departments to cover
hint: 8 to 12 departments for the persona tabs and dashboards.
example: SOC, OT/ICS and NERC CIP, Grid Operations, Wildfire Operations, Generation, Large Load, Customer Experience and IT, Physical Security, Executive Risk, AI Governance

label: Briefing date
hint: Month and year on the kicker line.
